split: Model-input duplicate groups: 60% train, 10% calibrate, 10% policy validation, 20% test; group split proportions mean row counts may differ. Same partitions/features for both models.

models.scorecard: Train-only WoE five-quantile bins + logistic C1
models.challenger: HistGradientBoosting max_iter200, max_leaf_nodes31, learning_rate0.05, l2_regularization10, early_stoppingFalse

calibration: Separate calibration partition: regularized logistic regression on clipped log odds, both models
threshold: Each calibrated model: minimum validation cost on fixed .01..99 grid, false negative5 / false positive1. Not actual money. No test threshold selection.
bootstrap: 2000 paired draws of test model-input groups, retain all rows of each sampled group, including label-discordant duplicate feature vectors. Fixed-model uncertainty only.
audit: SEX1/2 and age under30/30to49/50plus; group differences not discrimination finding or fairness certification.
scope: Single Taiwan2005 cohort; monthly predictors precede next-month label, but random client-group holdout NOT out-of-time or multiyear generalization. Existing-client selection; no observed LGD/EAD or IFRS9 compliance.
